name: npm-on-path
label: npm
description: npm is on the PATH and runnable.

commands.darwin:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
if command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  brew install node
else
  # No Homebrew (a clean Mac has none, and it would need Apple's Command Line Tools first): the official tarball,
  # unpacked under the user's home. No administrator password, nothing machine-wide.
  set -e
  case "$(uname -m)" in arm64) arch=arm64 ;; x86_64) arch=x64 ;; *) echo "Unsupported Mac architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
  base="https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x"
  tmp="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
  curl -fsSL "$base/SHASUMS256.txt" -o "$tmp/SHASUMS256.txt"
  entry="$(grep -E " node-v[0-9.]+-darwin-$arch\.tar\.gz\$" "$tmp/SHASUMS256.txt" | head -n 1)"
  [ -n "$entry" ] || { echo "No Node.js build found for this Mac" >&2; exit 1; }
  sha="${entry%% *}"; file="${entry##* }"
  curl -fsSL "$base/$file" -o "$tmp/$file"
  [ "$(shasum -a 256 "$tmp/$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sha" ] || { echo "The Node.js download did not match its checksum" >&2; exit 1; }
  dest="$HOME/.local/share/flowpad/node"; rm -rf "$dest"; mkdir -p "$dest" "$HOME/.local/bin"
  tar -xzf "$tmp/$file" -C "$dest" --strip-components=1
  for b in node npm npx; do ln -sf "$dest/bin/$b" "$HOME/.local/bin/$b"; done
fi
commands.win32: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $arch = if ($env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE -eq 'ARM64') { 'arm64' } else { 'x64' }; $v = (Invoke-RestMethod https://nodejs.org/dist/index.json | ForEach-Object { $_ } | Where-Object { $_.lts } | Select-Object -First 1).version; $root = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs'; $name = 'node-' + $v + '-win-' + $arch; $dir = Join-Path $root $name; if (-not ((Test-Path (Join-Path $dir 'node.exe')) -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $dir 'npm.cmd')))) { $zipName = $name + '.zip'; $zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP $zipName; Invoke-WebRequest ('https://nodejs.org/dist/' + $v + '/' + $zipName) -OutFile $zip -UseBasicParsing; $sums = (Invoke-WebRequest ('https://nodejs.org/dist/' + $v + '/SHASUMS256.txt') -UseBasicParsing).Content; if ($sums -is [byte[]]) { $sums = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($sums) }; $want = [regex]::Match([string]$sums, '(?m)^([0-9a-f]{64})\s+' + [regex]::Escape($zipName) + '\s*$').Groups[1].Value; $got = (Get-FileHash $zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower(); if ((-not $want) -or ($got -ne $want)) { [IO.File]::Delete($zip); throw ('SHA256 mismatch for ' + $zipName) }; if (Test-Path $dir) { Remove-Item $dir -Recurse -Force }; Expand-Archive $zip $root -Force; [IO.File]::Delete($zip) }; $user = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'User'); if (-not (([string]$user -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ -and ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($_).TrimEnd('\') -ieq $dir) })) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', ($dir + ';' + $user).TrimEnd(';'), 'User') }
